browser-control.description: Drives the user's existing Chromium-family browser with deterministic Playwright, reusing the real profile and logged-in sessions. Use when asked to inspect, automate, or test a visible browser tab, or to continue an authenticated browser workflow.

codegraph.description: Performs code analysis and semantic searches across this local monorepo. Use this server when you need to find function definitions, map codebase architecture, trace dependencies, or search for text symbols inside the workspace root.
